text.tspan: ’Tis so sweet to love my Jesus
Draw me, Lord, and win completely,
From all bondage, set me free,
Footsteps of the flock I’ll follow;
Charming love our hearts hath captured—
Thy love burns within as fire.
O what joy it is preparing
For our wedding with the Lord—
Stitch by stitch we are preparing;
Price we’re paying o’er and o’er
How we love Thee, dearest Bridegroom!
Long to hear Thy charming voice!
Thou our best and fairest choice.
Jesus, Jesus, how we love Thee!
